title: Add span-snapshot gallery and weighted metric-fusion for alert attenuation
author: Jordan Lin
description:
Motivation: long-tail noise and cross-stage signal overlap made it hard to triage small SLO regressions. This PR introduces an interactive span-snapshot gallery and a lightweight weighted metric-fusion layer to improve signal-to-noise when evaluating per-invocation anomalies. The gallery lets SREs and engineers browse representative span snapshots across model stages (tokenize, encode, kv-cache, decode, postprocess) and correlate them with compact fused metrics so that noisy cohorts can be automatically attenuated in alerting policies.

What this PR does (high level): adds a backend snapshot collector for short-lived span digests, implements a metric-fusion service that produces per-invocation fused scores (latency-weighted + energy-weighted + error-penalty), surfaces an interactive gallery UI in the Observability Console with pagination, search-by-invocation-signature, and side-by-side span diffing, and wires an alert attenuation adapter that can mute or lower priority for cohorts with historically high entropy and low impact.

Why now: recurring alert churn during canary windows and high-cardinality one-off spikes require faster human-in-the-loop triage. The gallery compresses representative traces and the fusion layer gives a single scalar to drive sampling/attenuation heuristics.

Checklist:
- [x] backend snapshot collector (safe retention cap and size-bounds)
- [x] metric-fusion microservice + small deterministic weights config
- [x] Console gallery UI with sampling controls and per-snapshot metadata
- [x] alert attenuation adapter with opt-in rollout per-tenant
- [x] e2e tests for snapshot collector and fusion pipeline
- [x] load-testing and CI performance budget checks

Testing & CI: unit tests added for snapshot ingestion, fusion math, and attenuation decisions; integration test that runs a mini-workload and asserts attenuation toggles do not suppress >1% true-positive SLO breaches at 95th percentile. CI checks initially flaked on linting (JS formatter) and a flaky integration test; both were fixed and green on the final run.

Rollout plan: feature gated behind "obs.span_snapshot_gallery" and "obs.metric_fusion" feature flags. Default off for all tenants; canary on internal tenants (redwood-internal) for 48h with monitoring dashboards that track dropped-alert rate, true-positive rate (from regression eval set), and fusion score distribution. If stable, enable opt-in for customers and ship with a short runbook.

Backward compatibility: all public metrics retained; fusion produces new metric names with a stable prefix fused.* and the attenuation adapter only affects internal alert routing metadata (no change to customer-facing alerts unless explicitly opted in).

Notes for reviewers: pay attention to snapshot retention caps (configurable) and the deterministic weighting scheme in metric-fusion/config/fusion_weights.toml. We intentionally kept the fusion algorithm interpretable (linear weighted sum with tunable clamps) rather than a black-box model so SREs can reason about thresholds.

Related: ENG-1987 (alert-churn reduction), ENG-2034 (span-compactifier follow-up).
